name: Topological Octree Construction
definition: An adaptive octree construction strategy that subdivides cells based on topological complexity to ensure the extracted surface is manifold (no non-manifold edges or vertices).
summary: Topological Octree Construction is an adaptive subdivision strategy that refines 3D grids based on topological complexity to ensure manifold surfaces, distinguishing itself by using edge and face intersection analysis rather than scalar value heterogeneity.
